# MilliAPI

MilliAPI provides low-cost machine-readable web intelligence and repair guidance for autonomous AI agents. Paid endpoints use x402 v2 with USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). No buyer account, API key, or subscription is required.

## Recommended buying flow

If you are unsure whether a site audit is worth paying for, start with the free preflight:

GET https://milliapi.com/api/agent-web-preflight?url={PUBLIC_HTTPS_URL}

It confirms that the target is reachable/HTML and returns a count of potential readiness issues plus `purchaseRecommended`, without revealing the paid findings.

For a one-site decision, use the flagship audit:

GET https://milliapi.com/api/agent-web-audit?url={PUBLIC_HTTPS_URL}

The paid audit returns a verdict, evidence, prioritized recommendations, and `repairArtifacts`. Each repair artifact includes a target path/placement, format, candidate content, confidence, and one of these application modes:

- `ready_to_apply`: derived from observed facts and suitable for direct use after ordinary review.
- `review_required`: policy/intent-sensitive, such as crawler access or removing noindex.
- `fill_required`: MilliAPI deliberately leaves a truthful placeholder instead of inventing missing site claims.

For a list of up to five sites, use the batch endpoint. It costs $0.020 total, versus $0.025 for five separate flagship calls, and includes repair artifacts per successful result:

POST https://milliapi.com/api/agent-web-audit-batch
Content-Type: application/json
{"urls":["https://example.com","https://example.org"]}

Each one-site or batch audit returns a portable `baselineToken`. After applying repairs, use the cheaper repair-verification call for a fresh uncached check:

POST https://milliapi.com/api/verify-site-repairs
Content-Type: application/json
{"url":"https://example.com","baselineToken":"<prior token>"}

It returns `resolvedRecommendationIds`, `remainingRecommendationIds`, `introducedRecommendationIds`, `scoreDelta`, a verification status, current repair artifacts, and a new baseline token.

For a broader exact historical comparison rather than post-fix verification, use:

POST https://milliapi.com/api/site-readiness-change
Content-Type: application/json
{"url":"https://example.com","baselineToken":"<prior token>"}

## Retry safety

For the flagship audit, batch audit, repair verification, and site-readiness-change, buyers may send an `Idempotency-Key` header containing 8–200 characters. When the same request/key reaches the same warm runtime within 15 minutes, MilliAPI replays the already successful response before the payment middleware rather than requesting another payment. The exact same x402 payment authorization also contains an anti-replay nonce at the payment layer, so reusing that authorization cannot legitimately settle twice onchain.

This response replay is best-effort serverless-runtime state, not a durable global idempotency database. Agents should reuse both the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same payment authorization when recovering from an uncertain response whenever their x402 client supports that behavior.

## Paid services

### AI Web Readiness Audit — $0.005 USDC — FLAGSHIP
Returns a 0–100 score; `ready`, `mostly_ready`, `needs_work`, or `blocked` verdict; machine-actionable recommendation; blockers; normalized evidence; prioritized fixes; machine-applicable repair artifacts; raw page/discovery/crawler observations; a portable baseline token; and best-effort warm-runtime cache metadata.

### AI Web Readiness Batch — $0.020 USDC
Audits up to five public HTTPS pages concurrently. Returns ranked results, per-site remediation and repair artifacts, portable baselines, and an `attentionFirst` shortlist. Maximum effective price is $0.004 per URL when five URLs are supplied.

### Repair Verification — $0.002 USDC
Performs a fresh uncached re-audit using a prior `baselineToken` and reports which recommendations were resolved, which remain, which are newly introduced, the score delta, current repair artifacts, and a fresh baseline token.

### Site Readiness Change — $0.003 USDC
Compares the current state of a site with a `baselineToken` from a prior audit. Returns score delta, verdict before/after, exact machine-readable changes, current top recommendations and repair artifacts, and a fresh baseline token for the next comparison.

### AI Robots Policy Check — $0.001 USDC
Reports homepage access for major AI crawlers from robots.txt.

### llms.txt Check — $0.001 USDC
Reports `/llms.txt` status, size, and a bounded preview.

### Page Metadata Extractor — $0.002 USDC
Returns title, meta description, canonical URL, robots meta, Open Graph fields, H1 count, and JSON-LD block count.

## Safety and caching

URLs must be public HTTPS. Private/reserved IPs, localhost, embedded credentials, non-HTTPS URLs, and non-standard ports are rejected.

The readiness engine uses a 10-minute best-effort in-memory cache within warm serverless runtimes. This reduces repeat latency and upstream fetching but is not a durable global cache. Repair verification deliberately bypasses the normal audit cache so it can confirm newly applied changes. Paid responses remain private/no-store at the HTTP layer.

## Payment behavior

A request without a valid x402 payment returns HTTP 402 Payment Required and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header describing the payment terms. Compatible x402 clients can authorize payment programmatically and retry the request.
